answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 188 aliases, and each one needs its own funded delta account. Deposits are visible in thread, and onyx reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 31% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 4774 identities would post 575 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
